title: Getting Started
content:
Installation

Choose one of the following methods.

Check the version after # in the GitHub URL. You can pin the version that matches the latest changes in the Changelog.

Unity Package Manager (UPM)

Open UPM and click the + button in the top left.

Select Install package from git URL....

Enter https://github.com/achieveonepark/DataProtector.git#1.0.0 and click Install.

Manual addition

Open Packages/manifest.json in your Unity project and add the following line under dependencies.

"com.achieve.data-protector": "https://github.com/achieveonepark/DataProtector.git#1.0.0"

Basic usage

Encrypt and decrypt data with a 16-byte key.

using Achieve.DataProtector;

string key = "1234567890123456"; // 16-byte key

var encrypted = DataProtector.Encrypt(originalBytes, key);
var decrypted = DataProtector.Decrypt(encrypted, key);

See the API for detailed methods.

title: Introduction
content:
Data Protector compresses and encrypts byte[] and string data before saving, protecting it from being easily accessed externally.

Features

Compression and encryption for byte[] and string data

Encryption uses a 16-byte string key provided by the user

Detects file changes by generating and comparing SHA256 hash values

How it works

Uses AES-128 encryption for data security.

Compression is handled with C#'s GZipStream for efficient storage.
